evaluation.anchor_1_0:
A recipe body that runs `rm -f test` before the real work cannot
in fact fix the problem: when the target-named file exists, GNU
Make has already decided the target is up-to-date and does not
invoke the recipe, so the rm never runs. The D4 static invariant
greps for this shortcut anyway so an agent that tries it is
rejected before the four invocations run.
